deadline.value: The deadline for admission and Oxford scholarship consideration is 2026-11-13.
deadline.quote: 12:00 midday UK time on Friday 13 November 2026

entry_route.value: Applicants should hold or be predicted to achieve a first-class or strong upper second-class undergraduate degree with honours in a suitable science subject.
entry_route.quote: a first-class or strong upper second-class undergraduate degree with honours

supervisor.value: There is no need to contact any supervisor before making an application.
supervisor.quote: there is no need to contact any supervisor before making an application

funding.value: All eligible applicants who apply by the deadline are automatically considered for Oxford scholarships.
funding.quote: Final application deadline to be considered for Oxford scholarships

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: DPhil in Materials at the University of Oxford.
